slug: 2025-01-01 An investigation of digital transformation initiatives in South African rural local municipalities

facts.fact: Interviews with nine departmental managers of rural local municipalities in Limpopo find that only communication has been digitally transformed, the municipalities using social media and Microsoft Teams, one manager citing a mayoral committee meeting a presenter joined by Teams; who provides the offices' connection is not stated and no date is given, so the published year is used.
facts.system: Office internet use at rural local municipalities in Limpopo (Microsoft Teams, social media)

systems.system: Office internet use at rural local municipalities in Limpopo (Microsoft Teams, social media)
systems.tiers: rural local municipalities (categories B3 and B4) in Limpopo; nine managers interviewed, no count of municipalities given

systems.system: Social media platforms used by rural local municipalities to communicate with citizens

note: Also stated, and not recorded as facts because they are of the capacity class or not about the office: rural municipalities lack IT strategies, skills and funds, digital projects are funded internally, and a Musina water pumping site has no network coverage.
